definitions.post5: Mean over annotated processed offsets +1..+5; includes GT-absent frames
definitions.visible5: Same window, exclude GT-absent frames; omit cases/videos with no visible frame
definitions.visible_available: Full post-switch suffix for native160; ONLY first five for bank
definitions.retention: 100 * method video-mean J&F / Warm Target video-mean J&F, same cases and window
definitions.target_frames: Separate actual processed target suffix frames from first-five scored target frames. Source Only=0
definitions.aggregation: frame mean within case, case mean within video, equal mean over videos; points 0..100
definitions.ci: Paired video bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 7, pointwise without multiplicity correction

native_evidence.window: Full suffix available; early-window metrics use processed offsets +1..+5
native_evidence.warning: Warm Target is native from original prompt, not always frame 0. DAVIS train is exploratory; some videos appeared in earlier evaluations, so this is not an untouched test.

bank_evidence.window: Only processed offsets +1..+5 available; GT-visible is GT-visible@5, not full suffix
bank_evidence.warning: Running fixed-order partial snapshot, not final full-bank result. No Warm Target predictions: all retention metrics unavailable. All-pool contains fitting/model-selection videos; video-disjoint cohort is the primary analysis. Do not combine with native-prefix experiment.

warning: Warm Target is an empirical reference, not a mathematical upper bound; retention can exceed 100%. Bank target tensors do not supply true native prediction scores. Old method/checkpoint results are not merged.
